# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Read and follow the repository-wide [AI guardrails](../Documentation/AI-GUIDELINES.md) and [project context](../Documentation/CLAUDE.md) before making changes.
- Move the full README content into the Documentation folder where feasible, while keeping minimal root-level recognized entry points/pointers for AI discovery and GitHub repository discoverability.
- Do not add or install Python libraries unless they are demonstrably required; prefer using dependencies already present in the project/environment and reuse existing tooling.
- Keep the repository root uncluttered while preserving AI instruction discovery; maintain canonical AI entry points in recognized locations and move secondary reference documentation into the Documentation folder.
